the_first_question_answered_what_k3_attn.source: moonshotai/Kimi-K3, modeling_kimi_linear.py (the TEXT model's file; modeling_kimi_k3.py is the multimodal wrapper and never touches the mechanism): KimiDecoderLayer.__init__ ~L907, _forward_attn_residual ~L973, _apply_attn_res ~L1075, KimiLinearModel.forward ~L1189, _apply_output_attn_res ~L1226. Read, not inferred from tensor names.
mechanism: config: attn_res_block_size = B (K3 declares 12; None means the ordinary residual)
per layer L: self_attention_res_norm [hidden], self_attention_res_proj [1, hidden]; mlp_res_norm [hidden], mlp_res_proj [1, hidden]
model: output_attn_res_norm [hidden], output_attn_res_proj [1, hidden] — REQUIRED and shipped
state per token: prefix_sum [hidden] (the running residual within a block) and block_residual [N, hidden] (snapshots of the state ENTERING layers 0, B, 2B, ...; N grows by one per block)

_apply_attn_res(prefix_sum, blocks, proj, norm): v = cat(blocks, prefix_sum) [N+1, hidden]; k = rmsnorm(v) with NO weight; score_i = sum_h k_i,h * (norm.weight_h * proj.weight_h) — ONE learned score vector, no query; probs = softmax over the N+1 candidates; out = probs @ v over the RAW candidates

layer forward: prefix_sum = h_in; if N > 0: h = apply(prefix_sum, blocks, self_attention_res_*); if L % B == 0: blocks.append(h_in), prefix_sum = None; a = self_attn(input_layernorm(h)); prefix_sum = (prefix_sum + a) or a; h = apply(prefix_sum, blocks, mlp_res_*) [always, even at N == 0 where it is a softmax over one candidate = identity]; m = mlp_or_moe(post_attention_layernorm(h)); prefix_sum += m; return (prefix_sum, blocks)
model: blocks start EMPTY; after the last layer h = apply(prefix_sum, blocks, output_attn_res_*) then the final norm and the head
the_first_question_answered_what_k3_attn.what_it_is: a THIRD residual topology, attention residuals: each sublayer READS a softmax-weighted mix over the block snapshots and the current prefix sum, and WRITES by plain addition into the prefix sum. Reduce is the attention; update is the add. It is not a Sinkhorn dialect in any form: no stream multiplicity, no per-token expand weights, no combination matrix. The [hidden] norm and [1, hidden] projection are the score vector's two factors.
the_first_question_answered_what_k3_attn.k3_numbers: B = 12, 93 layers, hidden 7168, first_k_dense_replace = 1 -> snapshots at layers 0, 12, ..., 84 = 8; the exit mixes 9 candidates; layers 1..11 mix over 2 candidates (the layer-0 snapshot and the prefix sum); at layer 0's attention site N == 0 and the mix is skipped, at its mlp site N == 0 and the mix is the identity

baseline_measured.existing_hc_tests_untouched: wave18_hc_carriage::k3s_residual_operands_are_not_sinkhorn_sites_under_any_stream_count pins that these are not hyper-connection sites; nothing here changes that.

baseline_measured.no_payload: Kimi-K3 is 2.8 T; no real-weight witness is possible on this machine, and K3's op plan does not close for reasons outside this rung. The execution witness for this rung is therefore SYNTHETIC by construction: a hidden-5-style substrate on an ordinary stack carrying attention-residual operands and the oracle's weights, as wave 19 did.

q1_where_the_traversal_enters_and_exits_: unchanged from wave 19's reconnaissance and now typed: decode runs a Carrier {Single, Bundle}, batch runs a Plane {Rows, Bundles}; each sublayer is a SITE entered through enter_site / enter_batch_site (producing the [hidden] branch input) and left through leave_site / leave_batch_site (folding the [hidden] delta back into the carrier). The ordinary operators consume [hidden] and never see the carrier. Attention residuals fit that seam exactly: enter = the softmax mix (reduce to [hidden]), leave = prefix_sum += delta (an add, not an expansion), plus two things the seam does not have today — a block-boundary EVENT at the attention site (snapshot the entering state, reset the prefix) and a required EXIT reduction (the output pair) before the final norm.
q2_what_the_plan_carries_today: nothing of this topology: ResidualTopology has SingleStream and HyperConnection only; larql-models parses no attn_res_block_size (detect/parser.rs reads hc_* at ~L465; the ModelConfig has hc_streams/hc_sinkhorn_iters/hc_eps and nothing for a block size); the surface carries residual_topology from the execution; the graph has no GroupClass for the output pair (the proj is Unknown/unplaced, the norm is mis-owned by FinalNorm); the KDA and softmax role tables carry no *_res_* role; the op plan has no site op for it. The carrier and site machinery from wave 19 is the only thing already in place.
q3_placement_relative_to_the_existing_re: entry: the embedding is the first prefix sum; blocks are empty (no replication, unlike HC)

order at a layer, from the reference: (1) when N > 0, reduce with the attention pair over (blocks, prefix) — reading the OLD blocks; (2) then, when L % B == 0, snapshot h_in into blocks and reset the prefix; (3) pre-norm, attention; (4) prefix += a (or = a after a reset); (5) reduce with the mlp pair over (blocks, prefix), always; (6) pre-ffn norm, FFN; (7) prefix += m. The snapshot is of the ENTERING state h_in, not of the reduced vector, and it lands after that layer's attention-site reduce

the existing residual-add sites (mod.rs leave_batch_site / decode.rs leave_site) stay adds — into prefix_sum, which is the Single carrier's own vector; the change is at ENTER (a mix instead of the identity) and at the boundary and exit events
pre-norms read the MIXED vector, as HC's read the reduced one
exit: apply(prefix, blocks, output pair) -> final norm -> head; required, and K3 ships it
q4_which_intermediate_state_can_witness_: per site per layer per position: the softmax probs over the N+1 candidates (a single-stream traversal has no such object; a mix that ignored the blocks would show probs = [0, ..., 1]); the mixed vector; the snapshot events (which layers appended, what they appended); the exit probs over 9 candidates. Assertions available once an oracle exists: A1 foreign (site probs and mixed vector equal the oracle's at every position for a given entering (prefix, blocks)), A2 structural (prefix_sum after a site == prefix_before + delta; the mixed vector == probs @ candidates), A3 branch input (pre-norm reads the MIXED vector — the same tap wave 19 used), boundary (blocks grow by exactly one at L % B == 0 with the entering state, never the mixed one), exit (the output pair is applied once, over all snapshots). Controls that must be caught: skip the mix (feed prefix_sum), mix over the normalised candidates instead of the raw ones, snapshot the mixed vector instead of the entering state, snapshot after attention instead of before, apply the mlp-site mix only when N > 0, skip the exit reduction.

layer_local: the two pairs (norm [hidden], proj [1, hidden]) per layer
the layer's own operators, norms, MoE — untouched
global_consumed_per_layer: B, the block size — one declared component fact (text_config.attn_res_block_size)
the snapshot set — grows with depth, read by every site after it, at width [N, hidden]
the schedule L % B == 0 — derived from the layer index, not declared per layer
stack_ends_only: blocks start empty at entry (no expansion)
the output pair at the exit — REQUIRED here; a component declaring B and shipping no output pair would be the analogue of GLM's headless case and must refuse whole-stack by that name
layer-range slices carry (prefix, blocks) in and out; a resume point for this topology is a (prefix, blocks) plane
q5_layer_local_versus_global.the_first_block_asymmetry: at layer 0 the attention-site mix is skipped (N == 0) while the mlp-site mix runs over one candidate; a reader of the reference who regularised the two would compute the same numbers only at layer 0 and diverge from layer 1 on — the attention site must keep its N > 0 guard verbatim

placement: a GroupClass for the output pair, owned by the text component exactly when it declares the topology (the HC head's rule), and the Norm fragment must stop sweeping output_attn_res_norm — an ordered, more specific fragment before the generic one

roles: four site roles (norm and proj at the attention and mlp sites) on every layer under the declaration, checked at [hidden] and [1, hidden]; strays refused on a single-stream component, as HC's are
